rolesAndResponsibilities: Developing, improving, and optimizing advertising formats for partner placements. Creating new formats and tools for configuring them. Participating in the technical implementation of A/B tests and analytics event tracking. Analyzing and resolving technical issues that arise during partner-side format integrations. Collaborating with internal development, analytics, and affiliate teams. Maintaining technical documentation for advertising formats and integrations.
